name: B10-0532/2026 (PPE) – Le cas de Paata Burchuladze et des prisonniers politiques sous le régime du parti Rêve géorgien
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It condemns the seven-year prison sentence given to Paata Burchuladze, a famous Georgian singer, and says other people are also held for their political views under the Georgian Dream government. It calls for their release, for fair courts, for access to lawyers and doctors, and for European Union countries to sanction named Georgian officials.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** Paata Burchuladze, other prisoners, Georgia's government and four named officials.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and member states, which decide on sanctions.
